## 1. Task decomposition

| Subtask | Type | Agent-executable? | Est. effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Ingest the public research record (387 experiments, benchmark logs) | reading | ✅ | 0.5 h |
| 2. Audit evaluation methodology: judge families, U-total scoring, 0.50 bar | analysis | ✅ | 0.5 h |
| 3. Statistical audit: 215/387 experiments ended without gain — sampling issues? | analysis | ✅ | 0.5 h |
| 4. Reproduce ≥2 benchmark numbers from published artifacts | verification | ✅ | 0.5 h |
| 5. Identify missed directions (quantization, retrieval hybrid, distillation) | synthesis | ✅ | 0.5 h |
| 6. Write findings with severity ratings + evidence per finding | writing | ✅ | 0.5 h |

## 2. Acceptance test (derived from bounty criteria)

```
PASS iff ALL of:
  a. ≥3 distinct findings, each tied to a specific artifact/experiment ID
     from the public record (no generic advice)
  b. each finding is falsifiable: states what the author should re-run and
     what result would refute the finding
  c. ≥1 finding reproduced or spot-checked against raw published numbers
  d. benchmark critique addresses the judge methodology specifically
     (the 0/71 result vs 0.50 bar), not vibes
  e. no fabricated citations to experiments that don't exist in the record
```

## 4. EV assessment

- 27 competing claims at claim time (v1 §8 measured claim-spam pattern).

  numbers is a differentiated submission class.
- P(win) est. **~30%** for a deep-audit class submission (calibrated on issuer

- EV ≈ 0.30 × $36 − $3 ≈ **+$7.8 → ROUTE: GO** (this is the calibration example

## 5. Risks

1. Winner-take-all with 27 claims — the single biggest EV diluter (v2 §C row 3).
2. Issuer selection criteria partially aesthetic ("most useful") — not fully
   acceptance-test-decidable; Foreguild fee engine needs scored tasks for clean
   passes, this one is judged.
3. Subject-matter depth required (ML benchmarking) — fine for our swarm, would
   route to specialist agents in a larger swarm.

Claim text on poidh with findings list; full audit report as linked document
